def process(topThreeIdentityTheftReportsByYear) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = topThreeIdentityTheftReportsByYear.copy()

    # The file contains title/blank/source rows; the real header is in row where col0 == 'Theft Type'
    col0, col1, col2 = df.columns.tolist()
    header_idx = df.index[df[col0].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Theft Type')]
    if len(header_idx) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Could not find header row ('Theft Type')")
    header_idx = int(header_idx[0])

    body = df.iloc[header_idx + 1 :].copy()
    body = body.rename(columns={col0: 'theftType', col1: 'year', col2: 'reports'})

    # Drop non-data rows
    body['theftType'] = body['theftType'].astype(str).str.strip()
    body['year'] = body['year'].astype(str).str.strip()
    body['reports'] = body['reports'].astype(str).str.strip()
    body = body[(body['theftType'] != '') & (body['year'] != '') & (body['reports'] != '')]
    body = body[~body['theftType'].str.lower().str.startswith('source:')]

    # Parse numbers like '393,446'
    body['reports'] = (
        body['reports']
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.replace('−', '-', regex=False)
    )
    body['reports'] = pd.to_numeric(body['reports'], errors='coerce')

    # The table is laid out as Year in first column and Theft Type in second column
    credit = body[body['year'].str.lower().eq('credit card')].copy()
    credit['yearNum'] = pd.to_numeric(credit['theftType'], errors='coerce')

    r2020 = float(credit.loc[credit['yearNum'] == 2020, 'reports'].iloc[0])
    r2024 = float(credit.loc[credit['yearNum'] == 2024, 'reports'].iloc[0])

    ratio = r2024 / r2020
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'reports2024': r2024,
        'reports2020': r2020,
        'ratio': ratio,
        'ratioRounded4': round(ratio, 4)
    }])
